source_report: Disease Weather Factors and Observation Windows.md

anchors.D: Observation date: photograph or symptom observation date
anchors.heading: Heading date of this field (H)
anchors.regional_first_report: Date of the regional first occurrence report

conventions.start_end: Offsets from anchor; negative values precede anchor. Calendar unit uses MM-DD; growth_stage uses stage codes
conventions.end_null: Null end means until end_anchor, or an unspecified interval if no end_anchor exists
conventions.core: True marks the core window for this disease
conventions.evidence_type: Source-based: a source or operational model directly specifies the period. Inferred: calculated from incubation or related information
conventions.leaf_wetness: Korean public APIs do not measure leaf wetness. RH duration or dewpoint spread is a proposed proxy; the collected approximately 77% accuracy claim is unverified here

key_weather_variables: Leaf-wetness duration and temperature during wetness
diseases.thresholds_text: Wetness requirements: 17 h at 15 C to 10 h at 22–25 C; previous five-day mean 20–25 C (Hiroshima BLASTAM). 20–25 C, at least three rainy days, RH at least 90%, and limited sunshine (RDA, Korea). Panicle infection: 0–300 degree-days after heading (Kobayashi et al., international). Sources: [Hiroshima BLASTAM Table 1](https://www.pref.hiroshima.lg.jp/uploaded/attachment/535771.pdf); [RDA 2023-06-15](https://rda.go.kr/board/board.do?mode=view&prgId=day_farmprmninfoEntry&dataNo=100000788240); [Kobayashi et al. 2010](https://www.jppa.or.jp/archive/pdf/64_02_01.pdf)
diseases.evidence_summary: Leaf window source-based; panicle infection window source-based; D-relative conversion inferred

windows.note: BLASTAM infection-day assessment: wetness duration by temperature during wetness
Required for the previous five-day mean temperature criterion of 20–25 C
Accumulated low temperature over 20 preinfection days (Tohoku method)
Kobayashi et al. 2010: 0–300 degree-days after heading

windows.applies_to: Panicle-blast conversion relative to observation date
windows.note: Alternative window when heading date is unknown

diseases.thresholds_text: 30–32 C and RH at least 96% (Korean). 28–32 C and canopy RH 85–100% (international). Sources: [RDA 2023-06-15](https://rda.go.kr/board/board.do?mode=view&prgId=day_farmprmninfoEntry&dataNo=100000788240); [IRRI](http://www.knowledgebank.irri.org/training/fact-sheets/pest-management/diseases/item/sheath-blight)

8–24 h leaf wetness (IRRI). Optimal germination at 20–30 C; invasion humidity 70% at flowering and 90% at milk stage (NCPMS, Korea). Sources: [IRRI](http://www.knowledgebank.irri.org/training/fact-sheets/pest-management/diseases/item/brown-spot); [NCPMS](https://ncpms.rda.go.kr/npms/SicknsInfoDtlR.np?sicknsListNo=D00000750)

windows.note: One-month accumulated cloudiness and rainfall

windows.matrix_text: Panicles susceptible through 25 days after heading
windows.note: NCPMS describes 25 days after heading as the latest infection time affecting yield

key_weather_variables: July mean temperature and monthly rainfall
diseases.thresholds_text: July mean 22–24 C, July rainfall at least 200 mm, wind at least 15 m/s; flooding 12 h: 8.8%, 48 h: 72.7% (Korean). 25–34 C and RH above 70% (international). Sources: [NCPMS](https://ncpms.rda.go.kr/npms/SicknsInfoDtlR.np?sicknsListNo=D00000744); [EPPO](https://gd.eppo.int/taxon/XANTOR/datasheet)
diseases.evidence_summary: Event window inferred (close to source-based); monthly criterion source-based

windows.note: Report label: inferred, close to source-based

windows.applies_to: Seasonal weather: July temperature and rainfall
windows.matrix_text: Seasonal window July 1 through late August
windows.note: NCPMS: July mean temperature/rainfall and rainfall from late July to late August

diseases.thresholds_text: Progression at 26–32 C, suppressed below 22 C (international source). Sources: [EPPO XANTTO](https://gd.eppo.int/taxon/XANTTO/datasheet)

windows.note: Korean occurrence unconfirmed

diseases.thresholds_text: Nursery optimum 35 C, asymptomatic at 20 C, sporulation at 24–32 C (NCPMS, Korea). Sources: [NCPMS](https://ncpms.rda.go.kr/npms/SicknsInfoDtlR.np?sicknsListNo=D00000752)
diseases.evidence_summary: Nursery criterion source-based; H+7 duration inferred

windows.matrix_text: Nursery symptoms: sowing date through D
windows.note: Nursery temperature: optimum 35 C, asymptomatic at 20 C

windows.applies_to: Seed risk in the following year
windows.note: Seed-production heading-date anchor; conditions source-based, H+7 duration inferred

diseases.thresholds_text: Frequent rain around heading, about 25 C and limited sunshine (RDA 2024-08-01, Korea). Rainfall 14–10 days before heading (JA Zen-Noh Ibaraki, international). Sources: [RDA 2024-08-01](https://www.rda.go.kr/board/board.do?mode=view&prgId=day_farmprmninfoEntry&dataNo=100000797460); [JA Zen-Noh Ibaraki 2714](https://www.zennoh.or.jp/ib/contents/make/einou/2714.pdf)

windows.note: JA Zen-Noh Ibaraki: rainfall 14–10 days before heading

windows.matrix_text: Extend through H+7 when applying the Korean description

key_weather_variables: Minimum and maximum temperature around heading
diseases.thresholds_text: Minimum at least 24 C around heading (Gifu, international). Sustained temperatures at least 30 C or frequent rainfall around 30 mm (RDA 2015-07-29, Korea). Sources: [Gifu Prefecture](https://www.pref.gifu.lg.jp/uploaded/attachment/302902.pdf); [RDA 2015-07-29](https://korea.kr/news/pressReleaseView.do?newsId=156066598)
diseases.evidence_summary: Core window source-based; H-3 and D-relative conversion inferred

windows.note: H-3 component inferred
Gifu Prefecture: minimum temperature at least 24 C around heading

diseases.scientific_name: Rice stripe virus, vector Laodelphax striatellus
diseases.thresholds_text: Transmission at 25–30 C, rare at or below 15 C (Jung 1974, Korea). Vector developmental thresholds 10.2/10.7 C (Park 2011, Korea). Sources: [Jung Bong-jo 1974](https://koreascience.or.kr/article/JAKO197425720625117.pub); [Park 2011](https://koreascience.or.kr/article/JAKO201106239853568.pub?lang=ko)
required_inputs: Region: whether on the west coast
diseases.evidence_summary: Short-term inferred; January 1 accumulation and qualitative winter conditions source-based

windows.note: Small brown planthopper developmental thresholds 10.2/10.7 C
Qualitative evidence: severe outbreaks after warm winters

diseases.scientific_name: Rice dwarf virus, vectors Nephotettix cincticeps and others
diseases.thresholds_text: Vector development thresholds: eggs 14.3 C, nymphs 13.3 C; oviposition lower limit 16.9 C (Tochigi, Japan). Transmission temperature/humidity unconfirmed. Sources: [Tochigi Agricultural Research Report 26](https://www.agrinet.pref.tochigi.lg.jp/nousi/kenpou/kp_026/kp_026_05.pdf)

windows.note: Development thresholds for green rice leafhopper: Tochigi, Japan

diseases.thresholds_text: Soil about 28 C and wet conditions (Vineeth 2025, international). Sources: [Vineeth 2025](https://www.uasbangalore.edu.in/wp-content/uploads/2025/09/37.pdf)

windows.matrix_text: Sowing to panicle initiation: approximately T-100 to T-30
windows.note: Use the sowing-date anchor if known. Korean occurrence unconfirmed
Unspecified interval

diseases.thresholds_text: 27–30 C and RH at least 75% (international source). Sources: [USDA CAPS 2016](https://caps.ceris.purdue.edu/wp-content/uploads/2025/07/Ditylenchus-angustus-datasheet-2016.pdf)

windows.note: Korean occurrence unconfirmed; quarantine relevance
Survival in dry tissue for 7–15 months

diseases.thresholds_text: 18–27 C and 6 h leaf wetness; 14 h dew for sporulation (international sources). Sources: [CPN](https://cropprotectionnetwork.org/publications/an-overview-of-northern-corn-leaf-blight); [Levy & Cohen 1992](https://consensus.app/papers/details/8f2c95d6defa54869526ee51ca3be04b/)

windows.note: 14 h dew for sporulation

diseases.thresholds_text: Warm humid conditions at 20–30 C; disease develops in 60–72 h (Korean source). Sources: [Nongsaro](https://www.nongsaro.go.kr/portal/ps/pss/pssa/sicknsSearchDtl.ps?pageIndex=1&pageSize=10&sicknsCode=D00001196&menuId=PS00202)

windows.note: Nongsaro: disease develops in 60–72 hours

diseases.thresholds_text: RH at least 90% for over 12 h; cumulative V4–V12 exposure (international sources). Sources: [CPN](https://cropprotectionnetwork.org/encyclopedia/gray-leaf-spot-of-corn); [Paul & Munkvold 2005](https://consensus.app/papers/details/dcb59be91bc05466ae1123e573e83cb1/)
diseases.evidence_summary: Seasonal window source-based; D-relative window inferred

windows.note: Korean occurrence unconfirmed
Paul and Munkvold 2005: hours at 22–30 C and nighttime hours at RH at least 90%

diseases.thresholds_text: At least 3 h wetness; daytime 16–25 C, nighttime 18–21 C (Cornell, international). Sources: [Cornell](https://www.vegetables.cornell.edu/pest-management/disease-factsheets/common-rust-of-sweet-corn)

windows.matrix_text: Introduction two to three weeks before the regional first report

diseases.thresholds_text: Optimum 26 C and 16 h dew; lower limit 16–18 C (international). Korean isolates germinate best at 25 C, declining sharply above 32 C. Sources: [Hollier & King 1985](https://consensus.app/papers/details/44f387775075552bb3ee61c7006bea08/); [Lee 2025](https://pmc.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/articles/PMC12337728/)
diseases.evidence_summary: D-relative window inferred; weekly index source-based (China)

windows.note: Back-calculated from September–October collection dates in Lee 2025

diseases.thresholds_text: Early growth at 26–34 C with little rainfall (international). Incubation 7–21 days (Korean source). Sources: [Illinois RPD 203](http://ipm.illinois.edu/diseases/series200/rpd203/index.html); [Nongsaro](https://www.nongsaro.go.kr/portal/ps/pss/pssa/sicknsSearchDtl.ps?menuId=PS00202&sKidofcomdtyTabCode=FC&sKidofcomdtyCode=FC040401&sicknsCode=D00001177)
diseases.evidence_summary: Susceptibility window source-based; seven days before silking inferred

windows.note: du Toit and Pataky 1999: silking through 8–14 days afterward

windows.matrix_text: Leaf/stem galls: wounding event D-21 to D-7
windows.note: Hail/strong-wind dates; back-calculated from Rutgers 10-day/three-week descriptions

diseases.thresholds_text: Infection possible in soil at 15 C, readily at 20–30 C (PNW). Soil moisture 15–25% (Illinois, international). Sources: [PNW](https://pnwhandbooks.org/node/2548); [Illinois RPD 203](http://ipm.illinois.edu/diseases/series200/rpd203/index.html)
required_inputs: Field occurrence history over three to seven years

windows.note: Soil temperature/moisture. Korean occurrence unconfirmed

diseases.scientific_name: Fusarium verticillioides and other FFSC species
diseases.thresholds_text: Above 25 C and preharvest wetness; fumonisin optimum about 24 C (international). Warm, slightly dry conditions (Korean source). Sources: [UT Crops](https://guide.utcrops.com/corn/corn-ear-rots/fusarium-ear-rot/); [Nongsaro](https://www.nongsaro.go.kr/portal/ps/pss/pssa/sicknsSearchDtl.ps?menuId=PS00202&sicknsCode=D00001173)
diseases.evidence_summary: Anchor source-based; 14 days before silking inferred

windows.note: Anchor source-based

diseases.thresholds_text: Silk susceptibility 2–6 days after emergence (CPN). Frequent rain during pistil formation (Korean source). Sources: [CPN](https://cropprotectionnetwork.org/encyclopedia/gibberella-ear-rot-of-corn); [Nongsaro document](http://www.nongsaro.go.kr/portal/ps/psb/psbk/kidoContentsFileDownload.ps?kidofcomdtyNo=29198)

windows.note: Silk susceptibility 2–10 days after emergence

windows.matrix_text: Rainfall from physiological maturity to harvest

key_weather_variables: Mean monthly temperature in December, January and February
diseases.thresholds_text: Sum of three monthly means in F: below 80 negligible, 80–85 low, 85–90 moderate, above 90 severe (Iowa State). Low likelihood when December–February daily mean is below -3 C (EPPO). Sources: [Iowa State 2009](https://crops.extension.iastate.edu/cropnews/2009/04/2009-prediction-stewarts-disease-corn); [EPPO](https://gd.eppo.int/taxon/ERWIST/datasheet)
diseases.evidence_summary: Winter window source-based; seedling window inferred

windows.note: Stevens–Boewe index (sum in F), EPPO -3 C criterion. Korean occurrence unconfirmed

diseases.disease_en: Goss's bacterial wilt and leaf blight
key_weather_variables: Hail, strong wind and blowing sand
diseases.thresholds_text: About 27 C; possible suppression below 21 C or above 35 C (CPN, international). Sources: [CPN](https://cropprotectionnetwork.org/publications/an-overview-of-gosss-bacterial-wilt-and-blight)
diseases.evidence_summary: Leaf-blight window inferred; systemic window source-based

windows.note: Korean occurrence unconfirmed

diseases.thresholds_text: Nighttime 21–26 C, sporulation at 18–23 C, and a water film in darkness for at least 4–5 h (USDA CAPS, p.2; international). Sources: [USDA CAPS](https://caps.ceris.purdue.edu/wp-content/uploads/2025/07/Peronosclerospora-philippinensis-corn-manual-datasheet.pdf)

windows.note: Hourly nighttime data required. Korean occurrence unconfirmed

windows.matrix_text: For systemic infection: sowing through four weeks after sowing

diseases.thresholds_text: Sporangia at 22–25 C, 12 h leaf wetness, soil at 28–32 C; high annual rainfall of 100–200 cm (USDA CAPS, pp.1–2; international). Sources: [USDA CAPS](https://caps.ceris.purdue.edu/wp-content/uploads/2025/07/Sclerophthora-rayssiae-var-zeae-corn-manual-datasheet.pdf)

windows.note: Korean occurrence unconfirmed

diseases.thresholds_text: Temperature/humidity thresholds unconfirmed; drought exacerbates symptoms (Awata 2019, international). Sources: [Awata 2019](https://pmc.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/articles/PMC7753892/)
